frame.name: Micro-Missile Frame
frame.description: This weapon fires a high-speed micro-missile in a straight line and deals reduced self-damage. Move faster with this weapon equipped.

origins.name: Indomitability

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

enhanced.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
enhanced.description: Reloading a short time after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

enhanced.name: Overflow
enhanced.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Lead from Gold
enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

enhanced.name: Bewildering Burst
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Recombination
perks.description: Elemental final blows increase the damage of this weapon's next shot.

enhanced.name: Recombination
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows increase the damage of this weapon's next shot. Damage accelerates faster.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.description:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

enhanced.name: All-Star
enhanced.description:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for an improved duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

enhanced.name: Ancillary Ordinance
enhanced.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

flavor: "In the heat of battle, Guardian, you will know the right choice to make." —Lord Shaxx
